title: Polymarket agrees to its first media partnership to supply Dow Jones outlets, including the WSJ and Barron's, with real-time prediction market trading data (Katherine Doherty/Bloomberg)
summary: Katherine Doherty / Bloomberg: Polymarket agrees to its first media partnership to supply Dow Jones outlets, including the WSJ and Barron's, with real-time prediction market trading data — Polymarket will supply Dow Jones with trading data under a new partnership, the latest in a string of deals between exchanges …
